premises.text: Remote clinics lack hospital imaging tools because devices are expensive or too bulky

premises.text: iPad-based ultrasound enables local diagnosis with touch imaging workflow
premises.evidence_span: We have built a new ultrasound solution working on an iPad

premises.text: Clinicians can capture, annotate, measure, and document exams including speech-to-text and voice memos

premises.text: Images can be shared over cellular or Wi-Fi so specialists advise without patient travel

premises.evidence_span: 14,900 euros, Ausgut is a great tool for emergency. This is one third of the price of the regular ultrasound device
